meta.parties: Martelis Appu v. Jayewardene Et Al

rules.statement: A married woman's agreement to sell land without her husband's written consent is unenforceable, but the money paid under such an agreement may still be recoverable.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that even if the alleged contract by the first respondent was bad and unenforceable under section 8 of Ordinance No. 15 of 1876 and section 2 of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840, the money paid under it was recoverable under the Roman-Dutch Law;"
